_comment: Every level-1 and level-2 heading in README.md and INSTALL.md at commit 5009a33,
the state before the docs/ tree was extracted out of them, with how many times
each appeared across the two files. tests/test_docs.py asserts every one of these
still appears exactly this often across README.md, INSTALL.md, and docs/**.md.
That is what proves the extraction moved prose rather than losing it.
Read from a committed fixture rather than from git at test time: a shallow CI
checkout does not have that commit's blob, and a later squash rewrites the sha.
